fusions.name: The Wait Ends
fusions.desc: Lunges up to 5 tiles onto a target and clamps, which deals 28 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Undertow
fusions.desc: Lays a line 5 tiles long ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 12 damage to each one it catches, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Stillness Decided
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Log in the Shallows
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike gains 40% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
